title: Querétaro investigates alleged hacking and leaks at municipal agencies including the SSPM; mayor asks people not to speculate
date_note: The article gives only its publication day, 24 November; it does not say when the alleged hack happened.
org: Secretaría de Seguridad Pública Municipal (SSPM), Querétaro
geo_basis: municipal agency in Querétaro city, as the article states
summary: Plaza de Armas reports that officials are investigating alleged hacking and leaks from several municipal agencies, including the SSPM. Mayor Felipe Fernando Macías Olvera asked people not to speculate. Globalmedia reports that SSPM head Juan Luis Ferrusca Ortiz filed a complaint with the state prosecutor (FGE) over a presumed intrusion; it says operations were not affected, and he said the FGE will determine whether an intrusion occurred.
plain: Querétaro's police secretariat has filed a complaint with the state prosecutor over a presumed intrusion into its systems. Globalmedia says operations were not affected; the prosecutor will determine whether an intrusion occurred.
exec: A Mexican city's police agency has filed a complaint over a presumed intrusion; the prosecutor is to determine whether it occurred.

validation.note: Two independent publishers (Plaza de Armas Querétaro, Publimetro) each state that the municipality is investigating an alleged leak/hack and checking whether the published material is authentic; Publimetro adds that the public security secretary Juan Luis Ferrusca said he will file a complaint with the state Fiscalía. Status stays developing: the hack itself is described as alleged.

review.note: Compared summary, date, mayor statements, FGE complaint, operations not affected and FGE to determine intrusion against Plaza de Armas and Globalmedia
